name: 56501 · Detroit Lakes, MN
findings: ZIP 56501 (Detroit Lakes) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56501 (Detroit Lakes) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
